# Tech Engi

> Tech Engi (techengi.in) is an AI-matched freelance engineering platform in India, operated by TSquareY1 OPC Private Limited (Chennai, Tamil Nadu). Founders, startups and companies post a bug, a stalled or half-built project, or a new build. Tech Engi's AI matches it to a verified Indian engineer (Aadhaar and PAN verified). There is no bidding. Clients pay 0% platform fee. The client funds 25% upfront into escrow, and the remaining 75% is released milestone by milestone after the client approves the work. Engineers keep 97% on their first completed project and 95% after that.

Key facts:

- Website: https://techengi.in
- Operator: TSquareY1 OPC Private Limited, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
- Contact: support@techengi.in
- Who it is for: founders, startups and companies that need a bug fixed, an unfinished project completed, a code takeover, or a new website or app built; and engineers, including engineering students, looking for paid project work
- Domains covered: software and bug fixing, web and app development, cloud and DevOps, embedded systems and IoT
- Matching: AI matching on stack, skills and track record, no bidding; typically 2 to 24 hours from posting to a matched engineer
- Client fees: 0% platform fee, 0% posting fee, no subscription, no success fee; the client sets the budget
- Payments: 25% upfront held in escrow, the remaining 75% released per approved milestone (example: a ₹50,000 budget is ₹12,500 upfront and ₹37,500 by milestone)
- Engineer fees: 3% on the first completed project, 5% after (engineers keep 97%, then 95%)
- Co-Worker for a Day: a verified engineer works alongside the client for one sprint day for a flat ₹3,480
- After delivery: clients can report an issue from the dashboard to reopen the work with the same engineer
